hypothesis: A deterministic linear SPO+ selector can exploit the 0.41-0.43 band-hit complementarity of four fixed actions plus their champion better than the fixed champion action.

feature_map.dispersion_scope: four base actions only, preserving S16; CHAMPION is one added scalar.
feature_map.preprocess: For each outer fold independently: replace nonfinite training values by training median (all-nonfinite fails), apply same medians to test, standardize by training mean/std with zero std replaced by 1.

cost_and_learner.cost: For valid y>=0.1*capacity, c_im=abs(a-y)/capacity/(6*n_g) - y*u(abs(a-y)/capacity)/(24*S_g); invalid rows cost 0. n_g/S_g are computed on that outer fold training surface only. Multiply the entire cost matrix by n_train.
cost_and_learner.predictor: chat=[standardized features, intercept] @ coefficients; choose argmin chat with action-order tie break.
cost_and_learner.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, analytic subgradient, zero initialization, lambda=0.001, maxiter=500, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-7, one invocation per outer fold, no retry or sweep.
cost_and_learner.optimizer_acceptance: Before scoring require finite coefficients/objective/gradient and final objective <= zero-init objective +1e-12. Report success/status; an unsuccessful but finite descending single invocation remains the frozen approximate solution and is not retried.

outer_procedure.Q3: fit only Q2 label-available rows; test 89 complete shifted days
outer_procedure.Q4: fit Q2+Q3 label-available rows; test 91 complete shifted days

two_phase_freeze.fit_phase: write predictions, choice trace, procedure provenance, optimizer receipt and family manifest; no Q3/Q4 metric/component call
two_phase_freeze.evaluate_phase: new process verifies all hashes then calls S17-N3 exactly once; no changes to predictions/family

evaluation.promotion: candidate point delta >=0.001635; stable promotion_eligible on blocks 3/7/14; Q3 and Q4 deltas positive; exact/additive sign agree; candidate in MCS and incumbent excluded.

failure_action: Any pre-score hash/feature/chronology/optimizer/family-freeze failure closes non-score with pre_score_gate_failed=true. After evaluation, gate failure closes score-bearing REFUTED and consumes comparison_index=1.
pass_label: SUPPORTED_RETROSPECTIVE only if the complete frozen promotion gate passes; otherwise REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE in scope
